summary: The comment opposes requiring cost-allocation of Head Start and pre-kindergarten students from E-Rate funding requests, arguing that these programs require internet connectivity for educational purposes and should be eligible for E-Rate support under existing definitions of a school. The FCC Notice proposes changes to the E-Rate program that would limit funding to rural or single-provider areas, narrow the eligibility scope for equipment and services, and reverse the presumption that activities on school property are educational purposes. The opposition argues that these changes would harm public programs, impose unnecessary administrative burdens, and fail to address the actual needs of schools and students. The comment opposes preserving existing State Master contracts under E-Rate, arguing they raise costs rather than lower them. It urges the Commission to decline changes that would require districts to re-bid on these contracts.
